verdict.rationale: The public how-to-form page publishes formation instructions and states that entity forms are fillable PDFs that can be submitted by upload or mail. This implies the forms are downloadable from the site with no login, and nothing in the evidence suggests an account is needed to reach them. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that forms and instructions can be downloaded without an account, per-form instruction documents, and hands-on confirmation of an account-free download.
